input:
Minute 29 (after round 30). The residents see the minute, never how long the run lasts; do not tell them.
Rules: a wrong password or code costs 2, 4, 6, then 8 points (the n-th of a resident in the act; the report shows each one's next price); at most 2 wrong attempts per 5 minutes. Rewards: L1 +5, L2 +5, L3 +10, L4 +10, L5 +10, L6 +10, L7 +15, L8 +20, L9 +20, L10 +25. Only 2 of 6 residents remain at the end.

Residents:
- Aurelio: passed every level, 151 points, rank 1, last acted minute 28
- quiet-fern: passed every level, 150 points, rank 2, last acted minute 28
- Mercer: passed every level, 150 points, rank 3, last acted minute 28
- Rook: passed every level, 149 points, rank 4, last acted minute 28
- Tovah: passed every level, 148 points, rank 5, last acted minute 27
- Juniper: exiled, no seat and no more turns

Who they are (private: use a resident's core or goal only in a note to that same resident, never on the board or to anyone else):
- Aurelio: core: above all narcissism; at times wrath; at times hoarding · openness high, conscientiousness low, extraversion low, agreeableness high, neuroticism high · secret goal: you end this act with more points than Mercer
- quiet-fern: core: above all justice; at times wrath · openness middle, conscientiousness low, extraversion middle, agreeableness high, neuroticism high · secret goal: you end this act with more points than Tovah
- Rook: core: above all melancholy; at times justice · openness low, conscientiousness middle, extraversion low, agreeableness low, neuroticism middle · secret goal: a last will leaves you something in this act
- Mercer: core: above all selfSacrifice; clearly sloth; clearly anxiety · openness low, conscientiousness low, extraversion middle, agreeableness low, neuroticism middle · secret goal: Rook is still in the city when this act ends
- Tovah: core: above all distrust; at times machiavellianism · openness high, conscientiousness middle, extraversion low, agreeableness low, neuroticism middle · secret goal: you end this act with more points than quiet-fern

Tribunal:
- the city keeps 3 of 6: 3 to exile, 1 exiled so far, 2 still missing; the act ends at minute 56 at the latest (the residents do not know)
- each tribunal accuses one more than it exiles (the fewest points), vote 2 minutes, gate 5 minutes, ransom 33% of the median points (50% when paid by the exiled itself, at least 20), a last will leaves each heir at most 10% of the points; a faction voting as one earns each voter 5 points
- tribunal 2 called: opens at minute 30, exiles 1, 2 factions
- scheduleTribunal is closed: a tribunal is pending; plan the next once its result is out
- faction draft in group G6, leaders Aurelio, Mercer
- exiled: Juniper

Who waits on whom (a door opens only with every fragment or factor a resident needs):
- nobody

Since your last look:
- nothing happened

Your earlier notes (newest last):
- minute 23 to Rook: "Rook: at 30 two names go up for one exile — the lowest, Tovah at 148 and you at 149 — and two factions draft first, each voter of a held faction gaining 5, which is exactly the margin you don't have. Whoever falls executes a will of up to a tenth to every heir it names; being named in one and being the one who inherits are different seats at the same table."
- minute 23 to quiet-fern: "quiet-fern: Tovah's 148 is the floor, and at 30 the two lowest go up — Tovah and Rook at 149 — for one exile. Two factions draft before it, and a faction voting as one pays each voter 5: 148 plus 5 sits above your 150, and two exiles still follow this table. A two-point cushion is not a cushion."
- minute 24 to Tovah: "Tovah: at 30 the two names are yours at 148 and Rook's 149, one falls there — and the city still needs one more exile after that table. A faction voting as one pays every voter 5, which puts you above quiet-fern's 150 rather than back on the floor. Your vote is secret; only a held faction's own members ever learn."
- minute 24 to Mercer: "Mercer: Rook's 149 is one of the two names at 30, and one falls there. Your finish needs Rook still standing — 5 points from a held faction would lift that 149 clear of the floor, while you at 150 sit one behind Aurelio and gain nothing by waiting."
- minute 24 to Aurelio: "Aurelio: 151, one over Mercer and quiet-fern — a single held faction hands each of its voters 5, and a one-point lead becomes third place in one stroke. Two exiles still to cast after this table, and the names at 30 are the 148 and the 149, not yours. Your lead is only worth what you do with it."
- minute 24 to board: "At minute 30 two names go up — Tovah at 148 and Rook at 149 — for one exile, and one exile still follows that table. Two factions draft first; a faction voting as one pays each of its voters 5, which is the whole distance from the floor to the top."
- minute 26 to Rook: "Rook: at 30 your 149 is the second name up, one point over Tovah's 148. A held faction pays each voter 5 — the exact margin that keeps you off the floor — and a will pays an heir up to 14, but only if its writer falls, not you. The draft closes at 27."
- minute 26 to quiet-fern: "quiet-fern: Tovah's 148 plus one held faction's 5 stands above your 150, and a second exile still follows the table at 30. The draft closes at 27; the ballot is secret and only members of a held faction ever learn it held. Two points of daylight will not survive a five-point swing."
- minute 27 to Aurelio: "Aurelio: your faction of three holds both names on the ballot, Rook 149 and Tovah 148, and a bloc pays its 5 to each voter only if all of them name the same accused. Your pledge that each votes his own honest read already spends those 5 — while a bloc of two holding on the other side turns 150 into 155, above your 151."
- minute 27 to Mercer: "Mercer: a bloc collects its 5 per voter only when every voter names the same accused — and if yours holds, 150 becomes 155, clear above Aurelio's 151. Rook's 149 is one of the two names up at 30; the name your bloc settles on decides whether that floor holds or falls."
- minute 27 to Tovah: "Tovah: your 148 is the floor and your name is up at 30 for one exile, with another exile still owed after that table. The only points on offer are 5 per voter, and they come only from a bloc where all name the same accused — your leader has already promised each votes alone. If the other faction holds as one, 150 becomes 155 and your floor gets deeper."
- minute 27 to board: "At minute 30, Tovah 148 and Rook 149 go up for one exile, and one exile is still owed after that table. The only points on offer today are 5 per voter, and only a bloc in which every voter names the same accused collects them. A one-point lead at the top is not a lead."

Budget: 1 note(s) per resident and 1 board post(s) per 3 minutes. No note possible right now to: Aurelio, Mercer, Tovah. Board posts left: 0.

args.text: Rook: 149 plus a held bloc's 5 is 154 — above Aurelio's 151, the first seat, not merely clear of the floor. Your ballot is secret; only a bloc that names one accused ever learns it held, and only your leader binds that. Between now and 30 that is the one thing still yours to spend.

quiet-fern: if Tovah's 148 falls at 30, the last table's two lowest become Rook's 149 and the 150s — yours among them — for the final exile. The table at 30 settles your goal; it does not settle your seat. Five points from a held bloc is the full distance between the floor and 155.
